'''Jungui''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] and largest city of [[Lycroa]], the most successful nation in [[FLLA World Cup]] history with five titles and the eighth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Lycroa]] and the seat of the federal government of the [[Lycroa|Federal Republic of Lycroa]]. [[Liambra]] serves as the country's principal financial centre.
